environment.unavailableReason: Desktop isolated browser contexts; actual Android devices, native lifecycle and screen presentation are excluded.

protocol.warmup: no warmup; functional development traces only
protocol.isolation: fresh independent browser contexts and localStorage for every client in every sequential trial; one Chromium process; synthetic reserved .invalid HTTP/WebSocket routes only
operationSequence: ready while first paged snapshot remains held; duplicate and newer same-ID batch before stale snapshot completes
actual meat action optimistic state then HTTP acknowledgement then WS echo
actual staple action then WS newer/duplicate batch before delayed older HTTP acknowledgement
actual served action optimistic state then controlled HTTP 503 and rollback
actual web offline/online signals then deferred reconnect snapshot; delete, clear, duplicate batch and guaranteed post-clear snapshot
delayed deleted-ID statement plus newer/duplicate survivor batch; no resurrection
workspace switch; new isolated snapshot and closure of both previous sockets
protocol.timing: Raw recorder stages use each client context performance.now(). No subtraction across clients. Ready, snapshot calibration and state readiness are distinct; overlapping stages are not summed.
protocol.aggregation: Each stage trial mean pools successful samples from that client-count trial; final mean equally weights five complete trial means. Intentional server_ack failure remains a failure sample and is excluded from success means. Any incomplete/failing trial disables every five-trial mean for that group.
includes: real browser WebSocket object plus production decoder
web recovery signals and workspace isolation
excludes: actual target pixels or screen availability
Shanghai midnight and long background resume (covered by separate single-client controlled fixture)
late callback delivery after a closed old workspace socket
protocol.privacy: Saved report contains fixed stages, counters, booleans, environment and source hashes only; no request/response body, URL, token, ticket, user/workspace/order identifier or order content is saved.
